access.notes: Standard hexagonal graphite lattice with known C‑C bond length (1.421 Å) and interlayer spacing (3.354 Å). The simulation box consists of 10 layers of 41×41 carbon atoms, all described in the instruction.

Lennard‑Jones well depths, collision diameters, anisotropy coefficients for C‑H, C‑C, C‑N, C‑O pairs; dipole moments, quadrupole moments, polarizabilities for water, ammonia, methanol, ethanol, and carbon; screening factors. All are tabulated in the task instruction.
